verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's Computer ecosystem documents an official CLI, but the docs say it has exactly one command, `cptr run`. Nothing shows it driving AI or agent workflows from the terminal (chats, tasks, automation); it appears to just launch the product. missing for 10: CLI subcommands for agent/chat operations, documented scripting or AI-native workflow usage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
